Methodology: Fixed seed; independent brute-force geometry and point-distance oracles; complete result-ID/multiplicity and ray/neighbor-distance checks before and after each measured round. Build/input/oracle/check/statistics are outside query timing. Each index materializes the same exact results into preallocated reusable Lists with one QueryContext; no per-query sorting is added unless required by the API. A full warm-up precedes timing. Median elapsed time and median per-thread allocated bytes across rounds; full GC before each sample outside timing. Diagnostic node/primitive counts use a separate untimed pass. Build operations count indexed objects; update operations count moved objects (RTree uses two API calls: Delete+Add). Updates use a fresh index each round and precreated old/new bounds; static structures do not appear in update rows. Box and precise triangle raycasts are different workloads. KD radius and sorted kNN use a separate point dataset and materializing scan baselines. No concurrency or GPU claims. Shared-host timings are not universal rankings.
